Testing the Installation

... for the Installation for Exhibition at Der Baum hat Zeit. The images and videos show a first bigger setup after Projecting onto a Glass Prism was tested. Several techniques are combined here. The prism is now rotated by an Arduino motor Arduino Motor Control. The interactive visuals are now controlled by the infrared camera of the Kinect.

For the final installation there will be an interactive synthesizer composition added to the installation. TouchDesigner to VCV Rack
